properties.name: M0003/26 / TNCC
properties.originalText: AERODROME BASH PHASE II IN EFFECT DURING THE BASH PHASE II PERIOD (1 OCTOBER - 31 JANUARY), AIRCRAFT WILL NOT BE SCHEDULED TO ARRIVE OR DEPART DURING THE BASH PHASE II WINDOW (1 HOUR PRIOR TO AND 1 HOUR AFTER SUNRISE AND SUNSET). DURING THE WINDOW, IF BWC IS LOW, ARRIVALS WHICH WERE SCHEDULED OUTSIDE OF THE WINDOW BUT ARE OPERATIONALLY PUSHED INTO THE WINDOW ARE AUTHORIZED ONE LANDING TO A FULL STOP WITHOUT A WAIVER. DEPARTURES WHICH WERE SCHEDULED OUTSIDE OF THE WINDOW BUT ARE DELAYED INTO THE WINDOW ARE AUTHORIZED TO DEPART WITHOUT A WAIVER IF BWC IS LOW. IF BWC IS MODERATE OR SEVERE, ALL AIRCRAFT MUST CONTACT IGUANA OPS TO OBTAIN 429 EOS/CC WAIVER APPROVAL WITH THE FOLLOWING EXCEPTIONS: EMERGENCY, LIFE FLIGHT/MEDEVAC, NON-CONTRACTED CIVILIAN AND FOREIGN AIRCRAFT; THESE AIRCRAFT DO NOT REQUIRE A WAIVER BUT WILL USE CAUTION AND OPERATE AT THEIR OWN RISK.
